description: Absolute memory budget ceilings for memcheck regression gating. Single source of truth consumed by cargo xtask memcheck and CI. Tightened to C-phase band after Plan 3 worker-aware memory accounting. Combined ceilings apply to main+worker RSS during worker-active phases.
tolerance_note: baseline_tolerance_pct widened 5 -> 10 (T8a, memory-pressure remediation). The box-idle RSS baseline is noisy under swap saturation: on bb76392e embed_idle measured 8020 KiB against a 7576 baseline +5% (7955) and flaked. 10% absorbs sub-10% jitter while still failing a genuine >10% regression.
